relation_to_naamp: Independent public dataset used for mechanistic concordance only; not a replication of NAAMP community boundary geometry and not a blind validation because the source publication already reports precipitation/hydropattern effects on calling.

source.dataset: Boreal Chorus Frog Calling Activity in the Central Platte River Valley of Nebraska in Spring 2015 - 2017

eligibility_gate.count_rule: Count numeric and bounded [0,1] on nonmissing days.
eligibility_gate.missing_rule: Use only rows with Missing==0 and finite Count.
eligibility_gate.consequence_if_fail: Do not fit the external gate analysis.

external_questions.hydric_gate: Is calling occurrence on a valid day associated with multi-day hydric opportunity (PRCP7 and HYDRO) after accounting for prior-day precipitation, temperature, seasonal date, site and year?
external_questions.site_context: Does the precipitation/calling relationship differ between the wet meadow and forested slough?
external_questions.persistence: Are PRCP7/HYDRO signals at least as informative as PRCP1, consistent with a multi-day gate rather than an exclusively immediate-rain cue?

activation.formula: active ~ z_PRCP7 + z_HYDRO + z_PRCP1 + z_TAVG + sin_DOY + cos_DOY + C(Site) + C(Year)
activation.inference: Report coefficients and 95% model-based intervals; repeat separately by Site as descriptive sensitivity.

positive_intensity.formula: Count ~ z_PRCP7 + z_HYDRO + z_PRCP1 + z_TAVG + sin_DOY + cos_DOY + C(Site) + C(Year)
positive_intensity.inference: Descriptive contrast only; do not compare logit and OLS coefficient magnitudes directly.

site_interaction.formula: active ~ (z_PRCP7 + z_HYDRO + z_PRCP1)*C(Site) + z_TAVG + sin_DOY + cos_DOY + C(Year)

prefixed_interpretation.temporal_gate_concordance: At least one of z_PRCP7 or z_HYDRO has a positive 95% block-bootstrap interval in the activation model; direction must be positive in both site-specific point estimates when estimable.
prefixed_interpretation.multi_day_over_immediate: At least one of z_PRCP7 or z_HYDRO is positively block-bootstrap-supported while z_PRCP1 is not the sole positively supported hydric predictor.
prefixed_interpretation.site_context_heterogeneity: At least one Site interaction for PRCP7 or HYDRO has a block-bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero.
prefixed_interpretation.no_threshold_dominance_claim: This dataset cannot establish NAAMP-style community recruitment dominance because it contains one focal species and a continuous daily calling index.

interpretation_boundaries: The source study already established precipitation/hydropattern associations, so this is mechanistic concordance rather than independent discovery.
Two habitats and one species cannot establish taxonomic or continental universality.
HYDRO has site-specific physical meaning (wet-meadow inundation vs slough/river hydrology) and is a standardized habitat-state proxy, not the same physical measurement at both sites.
Calling activity is not abundance or reproductive success.
No change to RC11 is authorized.

block_bootstrap.design: Within each Site x Year stratum, sort valid days and resample circular consecutive 7-day blocks with replacement until the original stratum size is recovered; concatenate all six strata and refit the fixed model.
block_bootstrap.support_rule: A coefficient is called bootstrap-supported only if its percentile 95% interval excludes zero in the predicted direction.

inference_robustness.primary_support_surface: Use block-bootstrap percentile intervals, not naive model-based intervals, for prefixed classifications.
